The scene is characterized by severe structural anomalies: several birds appear to be melting or fusing into the background, with wings detaching and floating independently. One bird on the right has a distorted body shape, while another in the center appears to have its head and neck separated from its torso. The texture of the water and feathers shows signs of smearing and lack of fine detail.
